recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-7829 unless a future pharmacy work-group decision changes the MedicationDispense.authorizingPrescription v2 mapping.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive pharmacy issue FHIR-7829 asked to remove ORC-3 Filler Order Number from the HL7 v2 mapping for MedicationDispense.authorizingPrescription, leaving ORC-2 Placer Order Number because the filler order number is scoped by the dispenser rather than the original/authorizing prescription.
initial_application: Historical commit 5bb461af1063efe577bac2b8b17b6992be7560bf explicitly named tracker item 7829 and changed the old MedicationDispense spreadsheet v2 mapping from ORC-3-Filler Order Number / ORC-2-Placer Order Number to ORC-2 Placer Order Number. The current StructureDefinition source preserves that corrected mapping after later source refactors.
additional_context: MedicationDispense is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/medicationdispense/structuredefinition-MedicationDispense.xml is in current build scope. Current source has the corrected ORC-2-only mapping and a targeted search found no ORC-3 or Filler Order Number text under source/medicationdispense. Jira search only surfaced FHIR-7829 for the targeted MedicationDispense query; Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant or conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active source already satisfies the issue, and other ORC-3 mappings in different resources are outside FHIR-7829's MedicationDispense.authorizingPrescription scope.
